items.source: Spring Data Elasticsearch operates upon an Elasticsearch client (provided by Elasticsearch client libraries) that is connected to a single Elasticsearch node or a cluster. Although the Elasticsearch Client can be used directly to work with the cluster, applications using Spring Data Elasticsearch normally use the higher level abstractions of Elasticsearch Operations and Elasticsearch Repositories.
items.translation: Spring Data Elasticsearch 基于由 Elasticsearch 客户端库提供的 Elasticsearch 客户端，该客户端连接到单个 Elasticsearch 节点或集群。 尽管可以直接使用 Elasticsearch 客户端与集群交互，但使用 Spring Data Elasticsearch 的应用程序通常会采用更高级别的抽象，即Elasticsearch 操作和Elasticsearch 仓库。

items.source: Client behaviour can be changed via the ClientConfiguration that allows to set options for SSL, connect and socket timeouts, headers and other parameters.
items.translation: 可以通过 ClientConfiguration 来改变客户端行为，该配置允许设置 SSL、连接和套接字超时、请求头以及其他参数的选项。

items.source: 1 Define default headers, if they need to be customized 2 Use the builder to provide cluster addresses, set default HttpHeaders or enable SSL. 3 Optionally enable SSL.There exist overloads of this function that can take a SSLContext or as an alternative the fingerprint of the certificate as it is output by Elasticsearch on startup (since version 8). 4 Optionally set a proxy. 5 Optionally set a path prefix, mostly used when different clusters a behind some reverse proxy. 6 Set the connection timeout. 7 Set the socket timeout. 8 Optionally set headers. 9 Add basic authentication. 10 A Supplier<HttpHeaders> function can be specified which is called every time before a request is sent to Elasticsearch - here, as an example, the current time is written in a header. 11 a function to configure the created client (see Client configuration callbacks), can be added multiple times.
items.translation: 1 定义默认请求头，如需自定义则在此处设置 2 使用构建器提供集群地址，设置默认的 HttpHeaders 或启用 SSL。 3 可选地启用 SSL。此函数存在可接受 SSLContext 的重载形式，或者作为替代方案，可以传入 Elasticsearch 启动时输出的证书指纹（自版本 8 起支持）。 4 可选地设置代理。 5 可选地设置路径前缀，主要用于当不同集群位于某个反向代理之后时。 6 设置连接超时时间。 7 设置套接字超时时间。 8 可选地设置请求头。 9 添加基本身份验证。 10 可以指定一个 Supplier<HttpHeaders> 函数，该函数在每次向 Elasticsearch 发送请求之前都会被调用——例如，此处演示将当前时间写入请求头。 11 可以添加用于配置所创建客户端的函数（参见 客户端配置回调），该函数可以多次添加。
